summary: XO Accounting is a Werribee, Victoria-headquartered Xero Platinum Partner selling fixed-price accounting, bookkeeping and payroll packages to businesses, SMSFs and rental owners across Australia and New Zealand. Managing Director Michael Kirby describes himself as a process-improvement enthusiast and has publicly described automating XO's onboarding with Practice Ignition and FYI. The practice is small, with some staff in the Philippines.

claims.text: XO Accounting (xoaccounting.com.au) is headquartered in Werribee, Victoria.
Michael Kirby is Managing Director of XO Accounting, in the role since July 2013 per LinkedIn.
claims.quote: Jul 2013 - Present (13 years and 4 months) in Melbourne, State of Victoria, Australia

claims.text: XO is a Xero Platinum Partner offering low-cost, fixed-price accounting and payroll solutions, with offices across Australia and New Zealand.
claims.quote: As Xero Platinum Partners, XO Accounting can offer you the low-cost, fixed price, simple accounting and payroll solutions

claims.text: Michael writes that he loves process improvement and calls XO one of Australia's leading exponents of technology-led accounting.
claims.quote: I have a love of process improvement and currently XO Accounting we are one of Australia's leading exponents of technology lead accounting solutions.

claims.text: In an FYI testimonial Michael says XO automated its onboarding using Practice Ignition and FYI, and creates tasks from Typeform and HubSpot via Zapier.
claims.quote: We’ve even automated our onboarding process using Practice Ignition and FYI.

claims.text: A directory listing says XO serves clients across Melbourne, Brisbane, Sydney and Auckland with a technology-driven approach.
claims.quote: XO Accounting brings a fresh, technology-driven approach to accounting for businesses and individuals across Melbourne, Brisbane, Sydney, and Auckland.

claims.text: Michael's LinkedIn headline lists a Xero Victorian Partner of the Year award and finalist placings for Australian and Innovative Partner of the Year.
claims.quote: Xero - Victorian Partner of the Year Melton City Council- Professional Services Business of the Year

claims.text: XO's workforce is small and distributed across Australia and the Philippines.
claims.quote: Its workforce is distributed across Australia and Philippines.

claims.text: XO's services include bookkeeping, financial reporting, virtual CFO, business coaching and financial planning.
claims.quote: Clients can choose from a range of practical packages, covering everything from bookkeeping and business coaching to virtual CFO support.

claims.text: The SMH reported in February 2025 that Michael Kirby was the accountant of Esprit Racing, a company placed into liquidation amid a Melbourne Cup prizemoney dispute, and that he declined to comment.
claims.quote: Before its liquidation, Esprit’s accountant was Michael Kirby, according to company records.

hooks.text: Michael's stated love of process improvement and his own testimonial on automating onboarding with Practice Ignition and FYI: reconciliation is the next workflow to automate.
Fixed-price Xero packages mean manual reconciliation hours come straight out of margin.
Multi-office (Melbourne, Brisbane, Sydney, Auckland) delivery with offshore support suggests standardised, repeatable reconciliation workflows are valuable.

risks.text: Michael Kirby appears in 2025 press as accountant of a liquidated racing company in a prizemoney dispute; not related to XO's services, but avoid referencing it and treat with care.
Very tech-forward already (Xero Platinum, FYI, Ignition, Zapier); may already use or be building automation for reconciliation. Small team.

gaps: No recent (2025-2026) posts, podcasts or videos by Michael found; most LinkedIn activity found dates from 2019-2023.
No job ads found for XO Accounting.
Facebook/Instagram pages exist but no posts retrievable.
Headcount varies by source (9 on LinkedIn; 11 in record).
